rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseHistory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published list of releases for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: platform
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents a runtime environment.
Provides an exploit assessment of a vulnerability.
A test action is a specific action associated with a test.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element optionally depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: simpleLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SimpleLicensing profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Built-in inline controls or mitigations prevent an adversary from leveraging the vulnerability.
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: binaryArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to binary artifacts related to a package.
Abstract class for additional text intended to be added to a License, but which is not itself a standalone License.
RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.
Points to a resource outside the scope of the SPDX 3 content that provides additional characteristics of an Element.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.
Products or commodities produced as a bulk unit are called bulk products. Commodities are often sold in bulk.
Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.
Describes one a profile which the creator of this ElementCollection intends to conform to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: syntactic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse tree used for natural language processing.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.
RequirementVerification class defines the base properties of a verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Concise Software Identification (CoSWID) tag, as defined in [RFC 9393](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9393/) Section 2.3.
Provides an independently reproducible mechanism that permits verification of a specific Element.
Class that describes an action that has occurred.
EvidenceRelationship defines the association between pieces of evidence and EvaluationResult.
ResponsibilityChangeProcess refers to the process of transferring responsibility from one party to another.
Agent represents anything with the potential to act on a system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assumes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element assumes each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software, to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: finetunedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been finetuned on the `to` Element(s).
The point in time when an element or an action ends, becomes no longer applicable, or becomes no longer valid.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this license or exception identifier was deprecated.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trackStar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: ("Track\*" in the SSVC spec) The vulnerability contains specific characteristics that may require closer monitoring for changes. CISA recommends remediating Track\* vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.
roleQualification specifies the requirements, criteria, or conditions that must be met for an entity to be considered qualified to fulfill a particular role.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 256, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.
Defines the end of a range.
A textual expression describing the actual need defined by the requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test artifact for the `from` Element (`from` hasTest `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Base domain class from which all other SPDX 3 domain classes derive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been validated on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packagedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a packaged instance of the `from` Element (`from` packagedBy `to`).
assignedBy identifies the agent that grants or assigns the role to the target element.
An assumptionUID is a unique identifier assigned to an Assumption item.
Specifies the value of the content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.
A concrete subclass of AnyLicenseInfo used by Individuals in the ExpandedLicensing profile.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: low
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 0.1 - 3.9.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Unlimited. Subject to standard copyright rules, the dataset may be shared freely, without restriction.
Inspection Process defines specific various processes needed to satisfy the inspection requirements for a specific product or service.
The boundary parameters define the area or region needed to describe a boundary.
City is a specific name used to define a locality.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: chat
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the instant messaging system used by the maintainer for a package.
An Agent responsible for product identification, such as an original equipment manufacturer (OEM).
Provides information about the completeness of relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verificationUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a verification management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a verification item.
A specification type defines the nature of a specification.
A collection of SPDX Elements describing a single package.
Specifies an Element where a vulnerability was found.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Identifier (IBID)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a verifiable unique identifier for legal entities as defined in the [ISO/DIS 25500-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/87705.html) draft standard. It is composed of three data elements: the International Business Registration Number (IBRN), the legal name, and the date of origin formatted as eight numeric characters (YYYYMMDD). Each element is separated by a pipe character (`|`) (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657|Code Management Association|19990420`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasHost
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build was run on the `to` Element during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the host that the build runs on).
Identifier for specific product is called a serial number.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element contains each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. The use of the `hasAssessmentFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: core
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Core profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact is in active development and is not considered ready for formal support from the supplier.
An out of specification action is defined in this class.
Impact justification label to be used when linking a vulnerability to an element representing a VEX product with a VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship relationship.
Provide context for a relationship that occurs in the lifecycle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasResolution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction points to the `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction that is addressed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a directory and all content stored in that directory.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: demonstration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Demonstrating and monitoring or recording that the item under verification to confirm that a requirement is met by the item under verification.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SupplyChain/ModifyAction is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Provides the license under which the SPDX documentation of the Element can be used.

referenceSpecification provides a reference to a DefinedType that defines the specific meaning, structure, and semantics of a Role. It connects the role to its authoritative source definition, ensuring consistent interpretation across different contexts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during the execution phase of an element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operatingSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an operating system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: extension
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Extension profile specification.
A location where a package or an item is being picked up.
Specifies whether the License is listed as approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
Domain in which the AI package can be used.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this ListedLicense or ListedLicenseException identifier was first added.
A value used in a key-value pair with a generic key that refers to an Element
The Boundary Definition Process refers to the process class used to produce boundaries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion about the type of support is made. This is considered the default if no other support type is used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: requirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides a requirement needed as input for another Element.
Weight to express relevance in de minimis consideration.
Confidentiality level of the data points contained in the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: underInvestigationFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability impact is being investigated for each `to` Element. The use of the `underInvestigationFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VexUnderInvestigationVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.
Provides an EPSS assessment for a vulnerability.
A text describing the design constraint defined by the assumption.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described by each `to` Element.
Specifies the VEX justification type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).
verificationMethod refers to the specific approach used for a checking an element's conformance with its requirements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) runs on each `to` /Hardware/Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
The action of product use.
Categories of presence or absence.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasVariant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: modifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is modified by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.
Conveys information about how VEX status was determined.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Serial Number (ISSN)](https://www.issn.org/understanding-the-issn/what-is-an-issn/) is an eight-digit identifier for serial publications and other continuing resources standardized by [ISO 3297](https://www.iso.org/standard/84536.html). It consists of two groups of four digits separated by a hyphen, where the final character is a check digit that may be an "X". The hyphen is retained when the identifier is stored electronically to maintain the standard 9-character string format (e.g., `1464-3693`). The ISSN is media-specific; the same journal title may be assigned different identifiers for its physical and digital versions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeCannotBeControlledByAdversary
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerable component is present, and the component contains the vulnerable code. However, vulnerable code is used in such a way that an attacker cannot mount any anticipated attack.
Test Process defines the testing process for an element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sourceArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an artifact containing the sources for a package.
Describes a relationship between one or more elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a test used to verify functionality on a software element.
Specifies the CVSS qualitative severity rating of a vulnerability in relation to a piece of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: categorical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such as the eye color of a population of people.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: notAutomated
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 0 - Not automated. No automation. The operator fully controls the system.
A distinct article or unit within the domain.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vcs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a version control system related to a software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other.
Property describing a parameter used in an instance of a build.
Energy consumed when finetuning the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [RFC 3874](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3874/).
Product Part Number as defined by OEM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mavenCentral
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html) and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.
A prescribed change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildMeta
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the build metadata related to a published package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) catalog.
This is the planned product associated with the change of responsibility.
Assessment of an Element for export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: providesSupportFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent provides support for each `to` Artifact. The use of the `providesSupportFor` type is constrained to `SupportRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: observation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Documentation of direct monitoring or witnessing of the demonstration of processes, tests, or any kind of system responses during a specified timeframe under specified environmental conditions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is no support for the artifact from the supplier, consumer assumes any support obligations.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: describes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element describes each `to` Element. To denote the root(s) of a tree of elements in a collection, the rootElement property shall be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gtin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin) is a number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a trade item (product or service).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: implementedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is implemented in the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: In addition to being supported by the supplier, the software is known to have been deployed and is in use. For a software as a service provider, this implies the software is now available as a service.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.

givenRole is a property that specifies the role being assigned in a RoleRelationship. It links the relationship to an instance of the Role class, defining the function, responsibility, or position that the source element confers upon the target element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).
Hazards are potential sources of harm, danger, or adverse effects to people, property, the environment, or systems within or related to a specific piece of hardware.
An element of hardware and/or software utilized to carry out a particular function.
Specifies a time when a vulnerability assessment was modified

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasProvidedDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a dependency on each `to` Element, dependency is not in the distributed artifact, but assumed to be provided, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
A mapping between prefixes and namespace partial URIs.
A property name with an associated value.
A Package that contains a dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalComponent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an optional component of the `from` Element (`from` hasOptionalComponent `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: log
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Time-stamped records capturing system or operational data recorded as usually as a response to specific triggers in a specified environment.
Provides a CVSS version 4 assessment for a vulnerability.
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
A collection of Elements that have a shared context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: install
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is used to install software on disk.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to store extra information about an Element which is not part of a review (e.g. extra information provided during the creation of the Element).
A software agent.
A characterization of some aspect of an Element that is associated with the Element in a generalized fashion.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtimeAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a runtime analysis report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sensor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded from a physical sensor, such as a thermometer reading or biometric device.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dalE
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Design Assurance Level E for aviation software assurance.
Provides a map of a property name to a value.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where only one of the elements applies.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.
The name of the recipient expressed in text.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: library
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software library.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dalA
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Design Assurance Level A for aviation software assurance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: formalStandard

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The software is not affected because the vulnerable component is not in the product.
A point representing the mean position of the matter in a body or system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: diskImage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a disk image that can be written to a disk, booted in a VM, etc. A disk image typically contains most or all of the components necessary to boot, such as bootloaders, kernels, firmware, userspace, etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: container
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a container image which can be used by a container runtime application.
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssociatedVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to associate a `from` Artifact with each `to` /Security/Vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: generates
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element generates each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDocumentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is documented by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseNotes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the release notes for a package.
Threshold that was used for computation of a metric described in the metric field.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: device
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a chipset, processor, or electronic board.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: phoneNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Phone number; A string of decimal digits that uniquely indicates the network termination point defined in [RFC 3966](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3966/) Section 5.
A probability score between 0 and 1 of a vulnerability being exploited.
Property that describes the digest of the build configuration file used to invoke a build.
Links a vulnerability and one or more elements designating the latter as products not affected by the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Natural Location Identifier (NLI)](https://eccma.org/enli-eccma-natural-location-identifier/) is a 14- or 15-character alphanumeric string standardized by [ISO 8000-118](https://www.iso.org/standard/85428.html) that uniquely identifies a three-dimensional geographic point location. rdf:Description.rdfs:label: license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.

Specification basis for the export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ai
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the AI profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOutput

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was made available for public use or reference by each `to` Agent.
EvaluationResult is the result of an evaluation.
Location is used to define the location, address or coordinates of a place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analysis
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Analytical evaluating of data, designs, or processes methodically to verify correctness against standards or expectations. Typical analysis methods are FMEA, FTA, STPA, static analysis for MISRA compliance etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data type is not known.
A value used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.
A place for the SPDX document creator to record a website that serves as the package's home page.

A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
